{{Quote|Why? What's on the shore of the Western Sea?''"<br />"''I know. It's the Emperor, isn't it? He's gone down to his villa by the sea.|[[Fars Sil-at]] and [[Acer Ash]]|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
The '''Emperor's Villa''' was a private retreat for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. It was located on the shores of the [[Great Western Sea/Legends|Great Western Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Sitting partly out over the [[Water/Legends|water]], the villa was not as large as the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], but was still considered a large structure and had its own grounds. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] it was the site of a [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|failed attack]] by members of the [[Whiplash]] resistance movement.<ref name="TLJ" />
